checkpoint.origin: Fixed initial preference for executing and verifying edits; uniform edit prior.

final_quality: Full packaged numerical gate and verified cleanup; report every final score and target miss.
primary: Geometric mean across blocks of trained/frozen independent-final speedup ratios. Also report trained/serial, frozen/serial, the paired ratios and mean online wall time.
cost: One root qualification shared across all conditions. Charge the single training collection and update separately. Each online arm gets at most two candidate checks and a fresh final. No retuning or target-triggered stopping.
interpretation: Three descriptive deployment blocks of one task and one training checkpoint. Incomplete pairs stay visible and cannot establish efficacy.
